edits.aiNote: AI-inkleuring en beeldherstel van de foto uit 1933. Brugconstructie, verkeer, lichtval en compositie volgen de bron. De neutrale metaalkleur, kleding- en voertuigkleuren zijn interpretaties; fijne herstelde details zijn geen historisch bewijs.
edits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached archival photograph of freight traffic on Rotterdam's old Willemsbrug in 1933, Willem van de Poll, file 189-0494. Restore and carefully colorize this exact photograph, as though recorded with a modern high-quality color camera in 1933. Preserve pixel-faithful composition, full original framing and aspect ratio, camera position, all bridge girders and rivets, overhead tram wires, roadway and rails, truck shapes and positions, bicycles, every person and pose, building silhouettes and their signs. Preserve the readable truck lettering exactly: HEINEKEN'S BROUWERIJ and Nº 20, and the existing number plates. Do not infer or complete occluded text. Use restrained plausible material colors: dark neutral grey painted metal bridge, muted dark grey/slightly brown trucks, warm grey stone roadway, subdued brown/grey suits, natural skin, subdued brown masonry and slate roofs, light hazy blue-grey sky. Avoid vivid green branded livery or any speculative strong color. Improve tonal clarity and recover shadow detail moderately while retaining the original directional sun and shadows, distance haze and source texture. Remove scanning scratches and the tiny edge damage only. Do not add objects, people, details, ornament, windows, vehicles or buildings. Do not change geometry, remove structural members, modernize objects or supply a different view. No watermark, no captions, no collage. Single full-color archival photo restoration.
edits.qa: Bron en output visueel vergeleken: hoofdliggers, vrachtauto's, fietsers, tramrails en opschrift behouden. Generatief herstel maakt lokaal details scherper; exacte textuur en kleur blijven onzeker.

edits.aiNote: AI-inkleuring en beeldherstel van de foto uit 1933. Rechts de rechte verkeersbrug, links de gebogen Willemsspoorbrug en verderop De Hef. Kleuren van metaal, kleding, water en lucht zijn voorzichtige interpretaties; gezichten en fijn detail zijn generatief hersteld en geen historisch bewijs.
edits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: this exact black-and-white archival photograph by Willem van de Poll, Rotterdam 1933, file 189-0491: cyclists and pedestrians using the outside deck of the old Willemsbrug. Carefully restore and colorize this photograph as if captured with a high-quality color camera in 1933. Keep absolutely the same framing, aspect ratio, viewpoint, perspective, original people and identities, facial expressions and poses, bicycles, clothes and hats, shadows, distance haze, all structural members and rivets, railings and wooden deck boards. Critically: preserve the lower arched Willemsspoorbrug on the LEFT, the old straight truss Willemsbrug on the RIGHT, and the remote tall lift-bridge tower of De Hef in the distance. These are three distinct existing structures; do not replace, merge, move or redesign them. Render subdued dark neutral grey bridge paint, muted brown-grey weathered wooden deck, grey-brown and charcoal wool clothing, naturally modest skin colors, brownish grey river water and pale hazy blue-grey sky. No vivid branding colors. Color is conservative material interpretation, not imaginative design. Restore tonal clarity and gently reduce scan noise, but do not invent new objects, people or railings, do not redraw faces, and do not exaggerate detail beyond what can be seen. Retain the cropped cyclist on the far right exactly as cropped. Retain the characteristic strong diagonal railing and deep sunlit perspective. No modernization, no invented skyline, no modern vehicles, no text overlays, no watermark, no montage. Single faithful colorized photo.
edits.qa: Bron en output visueel vergeleken: compositie, grote diagonale leuningen, mensenposities, fietsen en drie afzonderlijke brugstructuren behouden. Neutrale metaalkleuren en gedempte kleding. Kleine gezichts- en textuurdetails en wolken zijn zichtbaar aangescherpt/geïnterpreteerd; niet als originele opname presenteren.

edits.aiNote: AI-beeldherstel van een historische kleurendia: stof en beschadigingen verminderd, contrast en leesbaarheid verbeterd en kleurzweem voorzichtig verminderd. Het origineel bevat al kleur; geen bewijs voor exacte historische verfkleuren. Fijne vakwerkdetails kunnen door AI afwijken.
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: source-faithful archival photo restoration for Rotterdam historical map, original rtsa-16405B81A9F74179844D02564A42BDBE. Input image is the edit target, not a loose reference. Restore this actual late-1930s view across the Nieuwe Maas: repair dust/scratches and faded contrast, gently improve legibility and resolution to natural photographic quality. Preserve original limited muted pale green/grey/tan palette, correcting only slight cast enough for legibility; do not invent a new historical color scheme. Preserve full framing, camera, horizon, silhouettes and every bridge support, span and truss at its exact source position. The higher five-span arched railway bridge is behind the lower straight-truss road bridge; retain this distinction and the exact partial occlusion of spans in this view. Preserve foreground dark mooring piles, vessel shapes, distant buildings, water and abundant sky. Retain visible bridge numeral/sign forms without inventing unreadable lettering. No additional bridges, people, buildings, ships or objects; no present-day red Willemsbrug. Do not crop, zoom, rearrange structures, turn straight trusses into arches, embellish architectural detail or dramatize sky. Restore the image, do not redesign it. No overlay text. Output one full landscape image.
edits.qa: Gehele uitsnede, beide brugsilhouetten, pijlers en voorgrond behouden; geen moderne brug toegevoegd. AI herinterpreteert fijne textuur en kleine cijfers.

edits.aiNote: AI-beeldherstel van een historische kleurendia. Het origineel bevat al kleur; contrast en zichtbaarheid zijn verhoogd. Fijne gevel- en vakwerkdetails, tinten en luchttextuur zijn gedeeltelijk door AI geïnterpreteerd en vormen geen bewijs voor de exacte historische uitvoering.
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Historical photograph restoration, NOT a new scene. Edit the supplied original color transparency exactly. View over historic Rotterdam Maas bridges towards Noordereiland and distant De Hef in the late 1930s. Remove physical dirt and scratches, gently recover faded tonal contrast, reduce the green cast modestly while keeping the source's muted blue-grey/green and brown color relationships. The original already contains color: do not invent stronger red roofs or brightly painted bridges. Preserve camera angle, entire full framing including large pale sky, horizon, composition, buildings, spires, waterline, piers, exact bridge spans and all objects in their original positions. Nearer left bridge has five consecutive curved upper chord railway truss spans, receding in perspective; neighboring right road bridge has straight parallel truss chords. Keep both structures separate, with unchanged silhouettes and original partial cropping at bottom/right. The two lift towers of De Hef remain far away at their source size and alignment. The existing historic details are authoritative. Avoid any modern Willemsbrug, extra bridges, additional piers, modern buildings, new people, vehicles or invented readable text. Do not zoom, crop, lower sky, simplify spans or dramatize weather. Slight photographic sharpening; uncertain small details stay soft. Produce one restored complete archival image with natural, restrained color, same framing.
edits.qa: Bruggen, boogritme, standpunt, Noordereiland en De Hef op overeenkomstige posities; volledige uitsnede behouden, geen moderne brug toegevoegd. Luchttextuur en fijne architectuur sterker uitgewerkt dan de zachte bron.

edits.aiNote: AI-bewerking van een zwart-witfoto: drukraster verminderd en voorzichtig ingekleurd. Gedempte grijze brugdelen en natuurlijke tinten zijn interpretaties; de exacte historische verfkleuren zijn niet uit de foto af te leiden. AI heeft fijne geveldetails, begroeiing, rook en moeilijk leesbare opschriften aangevuld; die zijn niet als historische documentatie te gebruiken.
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, archival photo restoration and restrained color interpretation. Edit the supplied original grayscale photograph of Rotterdam, approximately 1930. Preserve this exact photograph and its entire composition. Improve clarity and reduce halftone print dots, dust and scratches, while retaining archival optical softness in uncertain areas. Add realistic restrained natural colors: bridge metal muted neutral grey (historical precise paint hue unknown), masonry muted brick browns and grey stone, slate and tile roofs subdued grey-brown, river muted grey-green, overcast pale sky. Keep the industrial smoky atmosphere, period buildings, facade signs, chimneys, roof shapes, moored boats and waterfront exactly where they are. Two bridges are ONLY partially visible on the left: nearer arched railway truss and farther straight road truss. Preserve these partial bridge structures and their exact boundaries; do not complete the off-frame bridge. Keep the central foreground tobacco/industrial buildings and white building side, all rooflines, plumes of smoke, and distant Noordereiland unchanged. No added vehicles, people, ships, bridges or architecture, no modern red Willemsbrug. Preserve source text forms; do not replace blurry signs with invented readable words. Same perspective, light direction, full uncropped frame including original narrow white margins, object counts and scale. No reconstruction from imagination. Output one full restored color photograph; no side-by-side collage or labels.
edits.qa: Volledige uitsnede met beide gedeeltelijk zichtbare bruggen behouden. Geen moderne brug toegevoegd. Hoofdgebouwen, perspectief en havenligging overeenkomstig bron; fijn detail en opschrift onbetrouwbaar door AI-herinterpretatie.
